scripts.build: tsc -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.build.json && corepack pnpm --filter @antidetect/web run build
scripts.dev:fake-api: tsc -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.build.json && node apps/api/dist/fake.main.js
scripts.test:integration: corepack pnpm run build && corepack pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && corepack pnpm --filter @antidetect/web run typecheck
